text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place health and safety system, specifically on activities, priorities, and performance during the fourth quarter of 2022, as well as overall health and safety performance for the year 2022. There was 1 lost time injury and 1 medical aid injury in the fourth quarter of 2022 which is an increase from the same period in 2021. During 2022 there were successful denials of 3 WSIB claims. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoiced costs for 2022 were 30 percent lower to those in 2021.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (January 19, 2023) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
